title: Relationship
description: A directed outbound edge from the artifact version that carries it to another artifact version. Legal rel_type values and target kinds are declared per kind in the kind manifest's x-registry-edges. Inbound edges are never stored. File spec sections 3.4, 4.3 and 6.

rel_type.description: Edge type, for example depends_on or supersedes.

to.description: Target as a fully qualified ref, resolved within the same root unless registry names another. Its version MUST satisfy range when range is present.

range.description: The versions of the target artifact this edge accepts, as a version range. Without it the edge accepts the version to names, and no other. File spec section 2.4.

registry.description: The canonical root, its registry.json url, of the registry to resolves in, when that is not this root. A client resolves it only in a registry the consumer already declares at that URL. File spec sections 3.4 and 11.
